title: Marketing And Mind Control
description: Bài đọc về cách marketing và quảng cáo lợi dụng bản chất liên kết của não bộ

words.example: The custom of giving diamond engagement rings was in large part manufactured by one of the most effective marketing campaigns in history.
words.collocation: marketing campaign · advertising campaign · launch a campaign
words.note: Cũng dùng trong chính trị: 'election campaign'.

words.example: In the early 1900s, diamond sales were declining, posing a serious problem.
words.collocation: decline sharply · decline in quality · steady decline
words.note: Cũng có nghĩa 'từ chối' (decline an offer). Danh từ: decline.

words.example: The advertising agency proposed reshaping social attitudes toward diamonds.
words.collocation: propose a plan · propose changes · propose a solution
words.note: Danh từ: proposal.

words.example: The agency arranged for movies to incorporate diamond engagement rings into their plots.
words.collocation: incorporate into · incorporate elements · incorporate feedback

words.vi: Đạt đến đỉnh điểm, lên đến cao trào
words.example: The campaign culminated with the slogan: 'A diamond is forever.'
words.collocation: culminate in · culminate with · efforts culminated
words.note: Luôn đi với 'in' hoặc 'with'.

words.example: This was achieved by exploiting the associative nature of the brain.
words.collocation: exploit resources · exploit a weakness · exploit workers
words.synonyms: take advantage of · leverage · capitalise on
words.note: Sắc thái tiêu cực khi nói về con người. Danh từ: exploitation.

words.example: Advertising comes in many forms, from blatant neon signs to subtly embedded products in movies.
words.collocation: blatant lie · blatant disregard · blatant violation

words.example: In each case, the goal is to mould our habits, desires and opinions.
words.collocation: mould public opinion · mould behaviour · mould character
words.note: Chính tả Mỹ: mold.

words.vi: Sự ồ ạt; trận tuyết lở
words.example: Our visual system is targeted by an avalanche of information on the internet, street posters, and billboards.
words.collocation: an avalanche of · avalanche of information · avalanche of complaints
words.note: Nghĩa gốc: tuyết lở. Nghĩa bóng: số lượng khổng lồ ập đến.

words.example: Our olfactory system is targeted by variations of vanilla and citrus perfumes aimed at enticing us to linger in a retail outlet.
words.collocation: entice customers · entice someone into · entice with offers

words.example: Perfumes are aimed at enticing us to linger in a retail outlet.
words.collocation: linger on · linger in the mind · linger over

words.vi: Kết cấu, cấu trúc (nghĩa bóng); vải (nghĩa đen)
words.example: They can be so successful that they change the fabric of our culture.
words.collocation: social fabric · fabric of society · the very fabric of
words.note: Trong IELTS thường gặp nghĩa bóng: 'the fabric of society' (kết cấu xã hội).

words.example: In the case of bottled water, we are swayed by advertising into paying for something that we can obtain for free.
words.collocation: sway opinion · sway voters · easily swayed
words.note: Nghĩa đen: đung đưa. Nghĩa bóng: thuyết phục, làm dao động.

words.example: Most people cannot distinguish bottled from tap water, much less between brands of bottled water.
words.collocation: distinguish between · distinguish from · hard to distinguish
words.note: Cấu trúc: distinguish A from B hoặc distinguish between A and B.

words.vi: Tính dễ bị ảnh hưởng, tính nhạy cảm
words.example: It is interesting to consider whether other animals exhibit anything analogous to humans' susceptibility to advertising.
words.collocation: susceptibility to disease · susceptibility to influence · increased susceptibility
words.note: Tính từ: susceptible (to).

words.example: It is interesting to consider whether other animals exhibit anything analogous to humans' susceptibility to advertising.
words.collocation: analogous to · broadly analogous · directly analogous
words.note: Luôn đi với 'to': analogous to + N.

words.vi: Sự bắt chước, sự mô phỏng
words.example: Humans and other primates exhibit multiple forms of imitative learning and this is called cultural transmission.
words.collocation: in imitation of · cheap imitation · imitation of
words.note: Động từ: imitate. Tính từ: imitative.

words.example: A component of advertising relies on the marketer's ability to tap into the brain's propensity for imitation.
words.collocation: propensity for · propensity to · natural propensity
words.note: Trang trọng hơn 'tendency'.

words.vi: Có xu hướng, có thiên hướng
words.example: If we are going to imitate someone, we are more inclined to imitate those who appear to be popular and appealing.
words.collocation: inclined to agree · inclined to believe · naturally inclined
words.note: Cấu trúc: be inclined to + V.

words.vi: Mang tính giai thoại, không có bằng chứng khoa học
words.example: Primatologist Frans de Waal provides anecdotal evidence of preferential imitation among chimpanzees.
words.collocation: anecdotal evidence · purely anecdotal · anecdotal accounts
words.note: Trong học thuật, 'anecdotal evidence' là bằng chứng yếu vì không qua kiểm chứng.

words.vi: Vô giá, quý giá vô cùng
words.example: Imitation is undoubtedly an invaluable ability.
words.collocation: invaluable experience · invaluable resource · prove invaluable
words.note: Cẩn thận: invaluable = vô giá (quý), KHÔNG PHẢI 'không có giá trị'. Trái nghĩa của valuable là valueless.

words.example: Often our propensity to imitate generalises indiscriminately, leading to poor decisions.
words.collocation: act indiscriminately · kill indiscriminately · used indiscriminately

words.example: Companies engage in stealth marketing campaigns in which people are paid to covertly promote certain products.
words.collocation: covertly monitor · covertly record · act covertly
words.note: Trái nghĩa: overtly (công khai). Tính từ: covert.

words.vi: Sự thao túng, sự lôi kéo
words.example: While we may like to believe that manipulation on a grand scale would not be possible, that's not to say that advertising is innately harmful.
words.collocation: media manipulation · political manipulation · manipulation of data
words.note: Động từ: manipulate. Tính từ: manipulative.

words.vi: Sự phổ biến, sự lan truyền
words.example: We must distinguish between the dissemination of information which is for our own good, and our manipulation for the benefit of companies.
words.collocation: dissemination of information · dissemination of knowledge · wide dissemination
words.note: Động từ: disseminate. Trang trọng hơn 'spread'.
